title: Console onboarding checklist UI (component, step states, deep links, and error/empty states) behind feature flag
creator: Dylan Brooks
project: Guided onboarding + first production launch checklist
body:
## Context
We’re shipping an in-console onboarding + “first production launch” checklist for Hosted API customers. This ticket covers the Console UI implementation: checklist entry point, list rendering, step status states, step detail UX, deep linking into relevant Console pages/docs, and robust handling for empty/error states. Gated behind a feature flag + cohorting.

Primary goal: reduce time-to-first-success (TTFS) and time-to-first-production (TTFP) by making required steps explicit and easy to complete.

## References
- PRD: guided-onboarding-first-production-launch-prd (Confluence)
- UX spec: onboarding-checklist-console-ux-spec (Confluence)
- Canonical step template: first-production-launch-checklist-template (Confluence)
- Progress API (dep): ENG-5813 + PR-28431 (checklist progress API)
- Feature flag (dep): PR-28467 (onboarding checklist flag + cohort rules)

## Scope (UI)
### 1) Entry points
- Add an entry point in Console home/dashboard “Getting started” area for eligible tenants.
- Add secondary entry point from Hosted API project/tenant overview page (same component).
- Ensure deep-linkable URL for checklist page (e.g., /onboarding/checklist) so Support can share links.

### 2) Checklist component + states
Implement a reusable checklist component that renders the canonical step list from the backend progress service:
- Step status rendering:
  - Not started
  - In progress
  - Completed
  - Attention needed (when backend marks step blocked / needs manual action)
- Step ordering is defined by backend payload; UI must not hardcode step order.
- Progress indicator: overall completion % + “X of Y complete”.

### 3) Step detail UI
- Clicking a step opens a detail drawer (or right-side panel) with:
  - Short description
  - Acceptance criteria (bullet list)
  - Primary CTA deep link (Console page) and secondary docs link
  - “Troubleshooting” section for top onboarding failures (401/403, 429 surprises, streaming disconnects, usage dashboard delay)
- CTA behavior:
  - Links should include source params for attribution (e.g., ?utm_source=console-checklist&utm_step=<step_key>)
  - External docs links open in a new tab.

### 4) Empty / ineligible state
- If tenant is not eligible for checklist (feature flag off / cohort excluded):
  - Do not show entry point.
- If user navigates directly to /onboarding/checklist but ineligible:
  - Render a friendly empty state with “This checklist isn’t enabled for your workspace yet” + link back to home.

### 5) Error / loading states
- Loading skeleton for initial fetch.
- Error state if progress API is unavailable:
  - Show “We couldn’t load your checklist right now”
  - Provide retry button
  - Provide fallback link to docs checklist page
- Handle partial payloads safely:
  - Unknown step keys should still render as “Additional step” (avoid blank UI)

### 6) Telemetry (Console-side)
Emit UI analytics events (names per onboarding-event-schema v1; coordinate with Logan/Nadia if updates needed):
- console.onboarding_checklist_viewed
- console.onboarding_checklist_step_opened (with step_key)
- console.onboarding_checklist_cta_clicked (with step_key + cta_type)

Note: Backend is the source of truth for step completion. UI events are for UX/funnel analysis, not progress.

### 7) Accessibility and UX requirements
- Keyboard navigable checklist list and drawer.
- Focus management when opening/closing drawer.
- ARIA labels for status chips.
- Status color must meet contrast requirements; do not rely on color alone.

## Non-goals (MVP)
- Full guided tours / walkthrough overlays.
- Automated remediation suggestions beyond static troubleshooting guidance.
- Private deployment onboarding wizard.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Eligible tenant sees checklist entry point and can open checklist page.
- [ ] Checklist renders steps from progress service and updates state on refresh.
- [ ] Each step opens a detail drawer with CTAs + links.
- [ ] Deep links navigate correctly and preserve query params.
- [ ] Robust loading, error, and ineligible empty state behavior.
- [ ] Telemetry events emitted for view, step open, and CTA click.
- [ ] A11y: keyboard + focus management + screen-reader friendly.
- [ ] Feature flag gating works end-to-end (no UI leakage for excluded cohorts).

## Implementation notes
- Use the shared design system components (List, Drawer, StatusPill, ProgressBar).
- Keep the component generic: accept a typed payload from progress API; avoid duplicating step definitions in the UI.
- Make sure we do not block page render on slow progress API; show skeleton immediately.

## Test plan
- Unit tests:
  - Step list rendering for each status
  - Error and empty states
  - Drawer open/close focus behavior
- E2E tests (Playwright):
  - Flag on: entry point visible; step drawer opens; CTA navigates
  - Flag off: entry point hidden; direct URL shows ineligible state
  - API failure: error state + retry
- Manual QA:
  - Keyboard navigation
  - Screen reader smoke test
  - Verify query params on all CTAs

## Rollout
- Dogfood first (internal tenants) behind flag.
- Enable for small cohort (Ben Carter to define cohort rules) and monitor funnel + support tickets.

## Risks / open questions
- Out-of-order event handling can cause step state regressions; UI should treat backend as source of truth and render monotonic transitions when possible (tracked in ENG-5866).
- Need a consistent mapping for deep links across step keys; prefer backend-provided URLs to avoid UI drift when docs IA changes.
comments: 2025-02-07 (Dylan Brooks): Created from Phase 1 MVP scope. Hooking into ENG-5813 progress service. Will align with UX spec from Kenji/Tessa once finalized.

2025-02-12 (Kenji Nakamura): Wireframes in DES-418. Please keep checklist entry point compact; copy max ~60 chars for the header in the home card. Drawer should support long acceptance criteria without pushing CTA off-screen.
2025-02-14 (Logan Wright): For UI telemetry, please emit console.* events as secondary; progress completion is computed server-side only. Avoid putting raw prompt/user content into event payloads.
2025-02-20 (Chloe Martin): Progress API response includes step_key, status, title, description, primary_url, docs_url. Recommend UI uses those fields and does not build URLs client-side.
2025-03-03 (Dylan Brooks): Implemented core component + routing behind feature flag. Added skeleton/error states. Pending a11y pass + final copy from DES-427.
2025-03-10 (Leila Farouk): E2E tests added for eligible/ineligible flows. Found focus trap issue when closing drawer with ESC; filed fix in same branch.

2025-03-18 (Dylan Brooks): Dogfood feedback: users missed secondary entry point on tenant page; adding small banner link under API Keys section. Also adding explicit note in troubleshooting about usage dashboard lag (~2–5 min).
2025-03-26 (Dylan Brooks): Merged via PR-28445. Flag verified in staging. Coordinating with Connor O’Brien for cohort rollout timeline.
2025-04-08 (Sean Gallagher): SRE review: ensure error state does not spam retries; use exponential backoff for auto-retry (max 1) and then require user click. Looks good.
